comments.author: arvynoo
comments.body:
The public alpha documentation preview is live at https://oddmash.github.io/oddmash-mobile/ from main commit `2adca864868d83127838fc95a52db06d736758f4`. Pages deployment [45849647399](https://github.com/Oddmash/oddmash-mobile/actions/runs/45849647399) succeeded. The public demo passed a Chromium and WebKit smoke check, and all five direct Markdown links returned HTTP 200 with contents matching the source.

The unpublished `@oddmash/mobile-interactions` tarball was installed in React 18 and 19, and the copyable examples were built and exercised in Next.js. The browser suite passed 55 cases with two browser-specific skips. Desktop accessibility checks, bundle and frame readings, and the paired filtering and inbox measurements are documented in [Alpha verification](https://oddmash.github.io/oddmash-mobile/docs/alpha-verification.md).

This issue stays open for physical iOS/Android testing, VoiceOver/TalkBack, a release performance budget, and npm publication. The example focus behavior after an application removes an archived row is also a follow-up from PR #17. The public site is the documentation preview.

comments.author: qtaghdi
comments.body: Resuming #7 under maintainer direction. Scope: current-candidate package and performance evidence, focus when the consumer removes a row, real device or emulator accessibility checks, and alpha registry release after the documented gate. Branch fix/mobile-alpha-release-verification.

comments.author: qtaghdi
comments.body:
Release verification update for #7.

- The archive example's focus restoration, typed CSS export, device checklist and the enforced gzip budget are on main via #31 and #32. The public documentation preview is live.
- Pixel 8 emulator, Android 16 API 36, WebView 133.0.6943.137, TalkBack 16.0.0.738667889. Demo tasks exercised all six components. TalkBack's speech display showed the archive confirmation and Next message in a React 18 consumer. Adaptive Dialog retained the edited value and focus through rotation with the keyboard open. The initial Refresh behavior lost accessibility focus while pending.
- The Refresh fix in #33 retained focus while preserving the in-flight guard. The run observed the pending and completion messages, then a failed request and successful retry in a clean package consumer. The failure text was readable on the next TalkBack item. The WebView baseline also verified that introducing a second touch canceled a pull without starting a request.
- The candidate `@oddmash/mobile-interactions@0.1.0-alpha.0` built in clean React 18 and 19 projects and passed `npm publish --dry-run --access public --tag alpha`. Archive SHA-256 `5f967b7d2db7096c16a9542eb332d6e703ae5758ff4871508928526877ebb396`. Public npm lookup returned 404. Registry authentication with publish access is still needed.

Remaining for #7: standalone Android Chrome and physical Android, iOS Safari/PWA with VoiceOver on hardware, the remaining device checks, and the verified public npm alpha. Apple does not provide VoiceOver in iOS Simulator.

Published the reviewed fix and the updated device guide via #34 at main commit `06acb22f14358615147f5285d9d6ec88d386c61f`. [Pages run 45922477806](https://github.com/Oddmash/oddmash-mobile/actions/runs/45922477806) succeeded. The live demo again retained Refresh focus and displayed pending and success through TalkBack in Android WebView. The public Markdown matches main. Releasing the active claim while device access and npm authentication are pending.
